query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Create and publish a HubSpot quote for a CRM contact by first finding the contact, creating a deal, creating line items and a quote, applying quote terms and template settings, publishing the quote, and inspecting quote/template properties.

HUBSPOT_UPDATE_QUOTE.description: Performs a partial update on an existing HubSpot quote's specified properties, identifying the quote by `quoteId` (either its internal ID or a custom unique property value if `idProperty` is provided).

quoteId.description: Unique identifier of the quote. Typically an internal HubSpot object ID, or a unique property value if `idProperty` is specified.

idProperty.description: Optional. Name of a unique quote property. If provided, `quoteId` is interpreted as this property's value, not the internal object ID.

properties.description: Properties to update on the quote (internal property names to new values). Only included properties will be updated.

HUBSPOT_GET_QUOTE.description: Retrieves a specific HubSpot quote by its unique identifier.

quoteId.description: Unique identifier of the quote; can be the HubSpot object ID or a custom unique property value if `idProperty` is specified.

archived.description: Specifies whether the quote to retrieve is archived (`True`) or active (`False`).

idProperty.description: Internal name of a unique custom property to use as the quote identifier instead of the HubSpot object ID; this property must have unique values across all quotes.

properties.description: HubSpot property internal names to include in the response; limits data returned and improves performance. Non-existent properties are ignored.

associations.description: Object type names (e.g., 'deals', 'contacts') for which to retrieve IDs of associated objects; fetches linked CRM object IDs. Non-existent association types are ignored.

propertiesWithHistory.description: HubSpot property internal names for which to include historical values; retrieves change history. Non-existent properties or those without history are ignored.

HUBSPOT_CREATE_QUOTE_OBJECT.description: Creates a new quote object in HubSpot CRM with specified properties and associations.

properties.description: A dictionary of key-value pairs representing the properties of the quote to be created. Property names are HubSpot internal names.

to.description: Object containing the ID of the existing object to associate the new quote with.

associationTypeId.description: The ID that specifies the type of association. For example, to associate a quote with a deal, use the appropriate HubSpot-defined ID.

associationCategory.description: The category of the association. HubSpot-defined associations are created by HubSpot, user-defined are created by users, and integrator-defined are created by integrations.

items.description: Request schema for defining an association type between objects.

types.description: A list of association types to create between the new quote and other objects.

items.description: Request schema for specifying associations to be created with the quote.

associations.description: A list of associations to create for the new quote. Each item specifies the object to associate with and the type of association.

HUBSPOT_SEARCH_QUOTES_BY_CRITERIA.description: Searches HubSpot CRM quotes using a text query, complex filter criteria, sorting, and pagination.

after.description: A cursor for pagination. Set this to the 'paging.next.after' value from a previous response to get the next page of results. If not provided, the first page is returned.

limit.description: The maximum number of quote records to return in the response. Default is 10, maximum is 200.

query.description: A string to search across all searchable properties of quotes. This performs a broad text search.

direction.description: The sort direction. Use 'ASCENDING' or 'DESCENDING'. Default is 'ASCENDING'.

propertyName.description: The internal name of the quote property to sort by.

items.description: Defines a sort rule for search results.

sorts.description: A list of sort rules to order the results. Only one sort rule can be applied. Each sort contains 'propertyName' and 'direction' ('ASCENDING' or 'DESCENDING'). If omitted, results are ordered by creation date (oldest first).

properties.description: Specific quote property internal names to include in the response. If omitted, a default set of properties is returned. Include custom property names here.

value.description: The value to compare the property against. This is required for most operators, except 'BETWEEN', 'IN', 'NOT_IN', 'HAS_PROPERTY', and 'NOT_HAS_PROPERTY'.

values.description: A list of values to be used with 'IN' or 'NOT_IN' operators. This is required if the operator is 'IN' or 'NOT_IN'.

operator.description: The comparison operator to use for the filter. Determines how the 'propertyName' and 'value' (or 'values'/'highValue') are compared.

highValue.description: The higher value for a 'BETWEEN' operator. This is required if the operator is 'BETWEEN'.

propertyName.description: The internal name of the quote property to filter by.

items.description: Defines a single filter to apply to the quote search.

filters.description: A list of filters to apply. Multiple filters in this list will be combined with an AND operator.

items.description: A group of filters. All filters within a group are combined with an AND logic.

filterGroups.description: A list of filter groups to apply to the search. Multiple filter groups are combined with an OR logic, while filters within a group are combined with AND logic. Maximum 5 filter groups with up to 6 filters each.
